description.value: The Reid Hotel is a 9-room boutique hotel in Vanderhoof, BC, occupying a landmark 1916 building that was famously relocated to its current site by a team of horses in the 1930s — originally known as the Egan, then the Mayo. The interior has been substantially reimagined with premium finishes including heated bathroom floors, Frette Italian linens, Nespresso machines, and Victoria & Albert freestanding bathtubs in select rooms. For touring cyclists on the long central-interior corridor of BC, it offers an unusually upscale overnight stop in a small northern community.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for The Reid Hotel at thereidhotel.com provides rich content across multiple subpages. The amenities page explicitly lists 'Secure wireless internet,' confirming Wi-Fi. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying area, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere on the site. The contact subpage provides a full address and phone number not present in OSM, and the OSM name 'Reid' differs from the full business name 'The Reid Hotel.' A set of five reviews on the front page share identical text under different names, suggesting placeholder/template content, though later reviews appear authentic.
concerns: OSM name is 'Reid' but the business trades as 'The Reid Hotel' — OSM record should be updated.
OSM record lacks address and phone number; both obtained from website.
Five front-page guest reviews share identical body text under different names, suggesting placeholder/template content on the website — does not affect legitimacy of the business but worth noting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active boutique hotel in Vanderhoof, BC with a functioning website, full contact details, and online booking. Useful overnight stop for touring cyclists on the central BC interior route.
enrichment_extras.notes: Dining room and lounge noted on amenities page as 'currently in development and coming soon' — no on-site food currently available.
